Case reference: 2011001999.CaseDesc: Abdulatif Salman, aged 25, suffers from schizophrenia. On the evening of October 23, 2010, he departed from his residence on Twyford Street in Ottawa, Ontario, on foot, lacking both financial resources and identification. He has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2020011959.CaseDesc: On May 4, 1986, James Masten, Patricia Heys, Mark Smith, and Kimberly Masten were seen for the last time as they left Bluffer’s Park in Toronto, Ontario, on a 16-foot boat. The four were heading out onto Lake Ontario.

She left driving her vehicle, which was later found parked on the side of the road near a walking trail about 7 kilometers from her home. She never went to the casino that evening.

Ywanna lives alone with no cell phone or computer.

Case reference: 2025062821.CaseDesc: Amarjit Jeerh boarded a plane departing from Calgary, Alberta on May 22, 1984 for Delhi, India. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2015069712.CaseDesc: On November 15, 2015, at approximately 1:00 p.m., Blake McCool was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020011471.CaseDesc: On February 2, 1975, at approximately 9:00 am, Stella Zayats was last seen by her husband as she left her residence to go for a walk in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020021517.CaseDesc: Ashley Collins was last seen on June 16, 2020 in Drayton Valley, Alberta. At the time of her disappearance, Ashley was leading a high risk lifestyle, and is diabetic.

Case reference: 2012020051.CaseDesc: Emily Ballantyne left Lynn Lake on the evening of April 27 1991, travelling to Thompson, Manitoba with two male acquaintances. Hair: Blonde, Long dark blonde hair with greying beard
Jacket: Denim, Blue, Young Life Creator brand

Case reference: 2020033565.CaseDesc: Eddie Ryan Burwell was last seen in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan in 2018. His last known banking activity was in Toronto, Ontario in May 2018. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003888.CaseDesc: Marcel Gauthier was reported missing by a family member on September 6, 1983. Marcel was living in an apartment in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec at the time of his disappearance. Marcel was last seen in his neighbourhood on August 17, 1983.

Jewelry: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, wedding ring on left hand

Case reference: 2014002557.CaseDesc:
On April 17, 2000, Craig Snider left his family's place in Coquitlam to go to work as a commercial fisherman at Stevenson Marina in Richmond, British Columbia and has never been seen or heard from since. 
Mr Snider commuted regularly from Port Alberni, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014002821.CaseDesc: On the weekend of August 18, 1972, Dennis Simpson and a friend went fishing on McMillian Lake in Manitoba. When they did not return by the 22nd, many people contacted the police. Through investigation, it was later determined that the two men were last seen by a man on the shore on Sunday the 20th, and their camp was still set up. They told the person that they were going to make one more pass and then break camp. The weather conditions at the time were such that there would have been rough water. Given this, and the fact that the men were in a relatively small canoe, it was determined that they may have capsized. An extensive search by land, water and air failed to find anything other than various items identified as belonging to the two missing fishermen. Dennis was never found.

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2020040144.CaseDesc: On May 28, 1950, Mabel Crumback was seen for the last time at approximately 12:30 am at her home located in Toronto, Ontario. Mabel had been babysitting her younger brother while her family was out of town. The following morning, she was gone.

Case reference: 2014001970.CaseDesc: On December 20, 1996, Wayne Hansen was seen for the last time as he checked himself out of a hospital in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2010003999.CaseDesc: During the evening of Friday May 28, 1999, Tammy Lamondin, age 20,  was with friends on Main Street in Newmarket. She remained in their company until sometime after midnight. In the early morning hours of May 29, 1999, Tammy left the Newmarket area with a male acquaintance. She was not seen again. The police conducted an investigation but were not able to locate her.

The next day, Chantal's mother went to her daughter’s residence, but Chantal was not there. The mother made several attempts to call her daughter without any success.

Case reference: 2013000089.CaseDesc: Daniel Marceau was last seen on June 7, 1989 in Montréal, Quebec. Daniel was despondent and told a friend that he was going up north to reflect on his life.

Cyril's boat capsized and his friends were unable to save him.  One of his friends saw him, approximately 2 to 3 feet under the water, beyond his reach.

Pierre’s truck and personal belongings were found in a dense, wooded area approximately 72 kilometers southeast of Route 275 in Balmoral, New Brunswick on August 17th, 1990.

Left Ankle, Chinese writing: strength, butterfly, musical note

Shoes: Leather, Veritough, one left shoe; size 7

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Jewelry: Wood, rope around the neck with wooden cross
Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom
Tattoo: Right Shoulder, sword and a cross
Left Hand, Text "Ozzy", one letter on each finger

Case reference: 2025067893.CaseDesc: The skeletonised remains of this young adult male were discovered in a ravine in Burnaby, British Columbia, on October 15, 2025. It is likely that he was missing for up to 18 months prior to being found, and he had sustained an injury to his right foot, which had become infected.

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 113 lbs, however this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Jacket: Black, Red, men's plaid hunting jacket
Jewelry: Gold, White, Yellow, ring; wedding band
Pants: Green, Ski slacks with elastic strap under the feet
Scar: Right Foot, from bone spur surgery

Case reference: 2012020028.CaseDesc: Chantelle Bushie was reported missing by her family on September 14, 2009. She has not been heard from since December 2007. Chantelle was known to lead a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2008015999.CaseDesc: John Zuern went missing on June 14,1975, from the London Psychiatric Hospital in London, Ontario. He was believed to have been living on the streets at the time.

Hair: Grey, Long, Unkempt; unkempt Beard, Moustache
Deformity: leg, walks with a pronounced limp

Case reference: 2006018499.CaseDesc: Tony Gikoff was last seen July 9, 1955, near Colborne, Ontario, at a property he rented to tenants. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2012020648.CaseDesc: Andrew Wiebe went missing from his residence in Saskatoon, SK on January 11, 1988. The vehicle he was driving at the time of his disappearance was later located abandoned in the Anglin Lake District, SK.

Case reference: 2012020088.CaseDesc: Norbert Couillonneur was last seen on May 27, 2010, at Pinehouse Lake, Saskatchewan, wearing blue jeans and a light blue T-shirt. He is known to travel regularly between Pinehouse Lake and Canoe Lake, SK.

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2014002021.CaseDesc: On August 28, 1973, James Martin was last seen in Richmond, British Columbia. It was speculated that James wanted to start a new life and assume a new identity. Robert has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001545.CaseDesc: On the morning of August 6, 1979, Timothy Papik and his daughter Diane left Rankin Inlet, Nunavut heading towards Whale Cove, Nunavut in a canoe. Timothy and Diane never reached their destination and they have not been seen since.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, Knife with snake, flower

Case reference: 2014003946.CaseDesc: Jean Siegel was seen for the last time on May 31, 1962 in Rivercrest, Manitoba.

Case reference: 2014002336.CaseDesc: On March 22, 1993, around 4:00 P.M. Yolande Bouchard was going to meet her sister at the mall in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Yolande never arrived and was reported missing at that time. Yolande's car was later found in Trois-Rivières West with two offence tickets on the windshield.

Case reference: 2012020065.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1979, Shane Olecka was reported missing to the Beausejour RCMP. Shane was last seen leaving his home the previous day to go rabbit hunting. He was an experienced woodsman and there was no logical reason for him to be overdue. The weather conditions worsened to 'blizzard-like' on December 3rd and made the search efforts very difficult. The police conducted ground searches with the assistances of a police dog, members from the Canadian Forces base and local volunteers. The ground search was terminated on December 8th due to inclement weather.

Jacket: Blue, Rabbit-fur trim on hood, 3/4 length

Case reference: 2025015368.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1966, the body of a burned man was found north of 18th street in Val-d'Or, Abitibi, Quebec.  A lighter was found near the body and a metal belt buckle was associated with the body.

Leggings: Lighter, found next to belt buckle

Case reference: 2012020121.CaseDesc: Mathieu Beauregard Messier was at home with his wife on April 30, 2008 in Farnham, Quebec. At approximately 7:00 p.m. that night, Mathieu told his wife he had to go see a friend and that he would be back later in the evening. Mathieu left alone in his wife’s vehicle and with her cellphone. At approximately 10:30 p.m. that night, police received a call that a vehicle was on fire on Rang du Haut-de-la-Rivière, near the military base in Farnham. The vehicle was identified as that of Mathieu’s wife, there was nobody inside the vehicle and Mathieu has not been seen or heard from since.

Teeth: Space between his two front teeth

Case reference: 2014006218.CaseDesc: Lori Kasprick, also known as "Lovey", was last seen in the mid-1970s. At that time, Lori's grandparents resided in Holden, which provided her with the opportunity to meet others of a similar age while visiting.

Case reference: 2014004801.CaseDesc: Beant Singh Khosa was last seen in Punjab, India on April 15th, 2006.  He travelled to India to attend his father's funeral and never returned.  It is rumored he has returned to Canada, however, his family and friends have not heard from him.

Case reference: 2014001767.CaseDesc: On October 15, 1991, Mario Chouinard was seen for the last time while hunting on the Zec Festubert(controlled harvesting zone) located in the municipality of Clovas in the Abitibi-Témiscamingue region of Quebec. Mario has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003380.CaseDesc: On May 9th, 1961, Brenda Byman was last seen on a hike with some classmates in the area of Wilmer, British Columbia, when she allegedly walked off into the bush and did not return. Brenda has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2024056795.CaseDesc: On December 27, 2008, the remains of an unidentified male were recovered from the shoreline of Lake Ontario near the Fort Niagara State Park in Lewiston, New York, USA.

Case reference: 2006017799.CaseDesc: Véronique Courchesne was last seen on November 11,1979, at her residence. She contacted her husband by phone on December 31, 1979 and hasn’t been heard from since.

Amputation: Right Chest, Mastectomy to the right breast

Case reference: 2005069040.CaseDesc: Yaseen is believed to be with his mother, Marina Zlonikova. They may be in the Ukraine.

Case reference: 2013000120.CaseDesc: In the early morning hours of June 30, 2002, Lisa Marie Young was seen for the last time in Nanaimo, British Columba. Subsequently, Lisa left with this male driver to get some food, but communicated to her acquaintances that she would be returning to them via taxi. She has not been seen or heard from since. Based on investigational information, the Nanaimo RCMP Serious Crime Unit believes that she may have been met with foul play. Police requests that anyone with information contact them directly.

Case reference: 2023025811.CaseDesc: On May 17, 1996, Andrea Robinson was last seen in Niagara Falls, Ontario, in the vicinity of Dufferin Island Park. At the time of her disappearance, Andrea was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:

Case reference: 2019070875.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a crawl space of a triplex in Montreal, Québec.

Case reference: 2014002231.CaseDesc: On September 25, 1980, Heinz Gamper was seen for the last time when he went mountain climbing in Jasper National Park in Jasper, Alberta. Following this time, Heinz was scheduled to work, but he did not attend his scheduled shift.

Case reference: 2006009499.CaseDesc: Frederick "Fred" Takerer was reported missing by his son on February 23, 2003. Due to physical limitations, he is unable to move around easily.  Police have been unable to locate Frederick, and their investigation is focused on the possibility that his disappearance is suspicious.

Case reference: 2016068711.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1969, an unidentified male was found 0.8 kilometres west of Sioux Lookout. His death appears to be self-inflicted

Case reference: 2017056443.CaseDesc: Kristina Ward is a 20 years old aboriginal female who has been missing since September 27, 2017. Kristina is schizophrenic and is possibly using drugs. Kristina is developmentally delayed and is described as being vulnerable and easily trust people she does not know.  Kristina has money and a cellphone, however, neither have been used or accessed since September 27, 2017. Kristina was last seen in Surrey at the intersection of 104th Avenue and 144th St. with an unidentified male.

Mark: Upper Lip, Birthmark on upper left lip

Case reference: 2012020112.CaseDesc: On February 14 2007, Philippe Lajoie was seen for the last time in Saint-Didace in the Lanaudière region, Quebec. He left his parents’ home at approximately 6 p.m. to go to a pig farm located on Petite-Rivière Nord road, in Yamachiche in the Mauricie region of Quebec. His vehicle was found there the next day.

Case reference: 2014016821.CaseDesc: On July 6, 2014, at approximately 7:00 a.m., Wally Giesbrecht went for a walk from a local motel on the 16 Highway bypass in North Battleford, Saskatchewan. When he did not return to the hotel, his family searched the area, including the shoreline of the North Saskatchewan River and Finlayson Island's pedestrian trails with the assistance of the North Battleford RCMP, while the Fire Department conducted a water-based search of the river, all to no avail.

Shirt: Cloth, Grey, Car logo on back
Sweater: Black, Hoodie with a possible logo

Case reference: 2013000132.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2008 Trevor Warkentin left the Pyschiatric Ward at the MSA Hospital in Abbotsford BC. A hospital staff worker believes seeing Trevor get into a red pick up truck, but no license plate was obtained.

Teeth: Good, Large gap between front teeth

Case reference: 2015049567.CaseDesc: Raymond Chalifoux was last seen on May 25th, 2015 at the Fort St John Hospital. Mr. Chalifoux received abdominal surgery and left the hospital against the advice of medical staff. He left in an unknown direction. Extensive searches were conducted with negative results. Mr. Chalifoux has not been seen or heard from since.

Vest: Black, Black vest with designs on chest
